title: RM-VLM: From Natural-Language Task Descriptions to Vision-Grounded Reward Machines
abstract: arXiv:2611.08308v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reward machines (RMs) have been proposed as a reward formulation in reinforcement learning (RL) to capture non-Markovian tasks where credit assignment depends on history. By representing reward functions as automata, RMs expose the task's temporal structure and allow such rewards to be handled within a Markovian framework. However, they assume a labelling function, a proposition-grounding oracle for observations, which must be manually engineered for each environment, limiting their wider applicability. translated_title: RM-VLM：从自然语言任务描述到视觉接地的奖励机
translated_abstract: 奖励机（Reward Machines, RMs）被提出作为强化学习（RL）中的一种奖励形式化方法，用于捕捉信用分配依赖于历史的非马尔可夫任务。通过将奖励函数表示为自动机，RM 揭示了任务的时间结构，并使得此类奖励可以在马尔可夫框架内处理。然而，RM 假设存在一个标注函数，即一个针对观测的命题接地预言机，该函数必须针对每个环境手动设计，这限制了其更广泛的适用性。在这项工作中，我们通过提出 RM-VLM 来解决这一局限，这是一种新方法：由大语言模型（LLM）根据自然语言任务描述生成 RM，并由视觉-语言模型（VLM）充当标注函数，在 RM 引导的策略学习过程中将 RM 的命题接地于基于图像的观测之上。同时，基于 VLM 的价值函数估计器被用于评估智能体向每个 RM 转移的进展（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出 RM-VLM，利用大语言模型从自然语言任务描述自动生成奖励机，并让视觉-语言模型充当标注函数将命题接地于图像观测，从而免除传统奖励机中需要针对每个环境手动设计标注函数的局限。
en_tdlr: RM-VLM employs an LLM to automatically generate reward machines from natural-language task descriptions and a vision-language model as the labelling function to ground propositions on image observations, eliminating the need for manually engineered labelling functions in each environment.
